description: Create js_analyzer.py - JavaScript Intelligence Engine. Downloads and analyzes JS files from discovered endpoints to extract API endpoints, secrets, tokens, internal URLs, authentication flows, GraphQL queries, WebSocket endpoints, and deprecated API versions.
steps: Create /projects/sandbox/Bug-Bounty/monster/js_analyzer.py with a JSAnalyzer class that takes a list of URLs/domains and output_dir

Implement JS file discovery: (a) parse HTML pages for <script src=...> tags, (b) check common JS paths (/static/js/, /assets/js/, /dist/, /bundle.js, /app.js, /main.js, /vendor.js, /chunk-*.js), (c) find .map source map files by appending .map to discovered JS URLs
Implement JS content downloader with rate limiting and size limits (skip files > 10MB)

Implement API endpoint extraction: regex patterns for fetch('/path'), axios.get('/path'), $.ajax({url:'/path'}), XMLHttpRequest '/path', /api/v[0-9]+/*, relative and absolute URL patterns, router definitions (React Router, Vue Router, Angular routes)

Implement secret extraction using patterns from config.py: AWS access keys (AKIA...), AWS secret keys, Firebase configs (apiKey, authDomain, databaseURL, projectId, storageBucket, messagingSenderId, appId), Stripe keys (sk_live_, pk_live_, sk_test_), Google API keys, GitHub tokens, Slack tokens/webhooks, Twilio credentials, SendGrid keys, Mailgun keys, JWT tokens, private keys, database connection strings, generic password/secret/token/api_key assignments
Implement authentication flow detection: find OAuth endpoints, token refresh logic, JWT decode/verify patterns, session management, CSRF token handling, authorization header construction
Implement GraphQL detection: find queries/mutations (gql`...`, query {...}, mutation {...}), GraphQL endpoint URLs (/graphql, /gql, /api/graphql), schema introspection indicators
Implement WebSocket endpoint detection: ws:// and wss:// URLs, new WebSocket() calls, Socket.IO connections, SockJS patterns
Implement API version detection: find /api/v1/, /api/v2/, /v1/, /v2/ patterns, identify potentially deprecated old versions alongside newer ones
Implement commented-out code detection and debug endpoint detection (console.log with sensitive data, debugger statements, //TODO/FIXME/HACK comments revealing internal info)

Add a run() method that discovers JS files, downloads them, runs all extractors, deduplicates results, and saves structured output (JSON with categories: endpoints, secrets, auth_flows, graphql, websockets, debug_info)
Add summary output showing most critical findings (secrets always flagged as critical)
acceptance_criteria: JSAnalyzer correctly extracts API endpoints from sample JS content
Secret patterns detect AWS keys, Firebase configs, and generic tokens in test strings
GraphQL query extraction works on sample gql template literals
WebSocket URL extraction identifies ws:// and wss:// endpoints
verification: python -c "from monster.js_analyzer import JSAnalyzer; print('js_analyzer import OK')"

python -c "from monster.js_analyzer import JSAnalyzer; a = JSAnalyzer(['https://example.com'], '/tmp/js-test'); print(a.extract_secrets_from_content('var key = \"AKIA1234567890ABCDEF\"; var fb = {apiKey: \"AIzaSyABC123\"}'))"
findings: All verification commands pass. Import works cleanly. Secret extraction correctly detects AWS Access Keys (AKIA pattern) and Google API Keys with proper-length values. The short test value 'AIzaSyABC123' does not match because the Google API Key regex requires AIza + 35 chars (by design). Firebase config object detection works when apiKey, authDomain, and projectId appear within 10 lines of each other. Endpoint extraction finds fetch() and axios.get() calls. GraphQL, WebSocket, auth flow, API version, and debug detection all work as expected. Console debug pattern correctly distinguishes static-only log statements from those with variable content.
